name: search_stock_media
description:
Search curated public stock-media platforms for B-roll, photos, sounds, and music.

Use this before importing stock media. It normalizes results from API-backed providers with direct import URLs (Pexels, Pixabay, Unsplash, Freesound).

If you omit platforms, ChatCut searches only providers relevant to kind: video searches video providers, image searches image providers, audio/music searches sound/music providers, and any searches the full catalog.

Friendly workflow:
1. Search with query + kind + optional platforms/category/orientation.
2. Read title/description/tags/license/attribution/pageUrl before choosing.
3. Download the selected result.downloadUrl to a readable local path using result.downloadFilename, then call push_asset with that local path. For audio/video transcript work, call track_progress target=transcription for the returned asset id before reading transcript/captions.

category.description: Optional category/context such as business, nature, food, technology, whoosh, piano, ambient.

kind.description: Media kind to search: video, audio, music, image, or any.

limitPerPlatform.description: Maximum normalized results per platform. Defaults to 3.

orientation.description: Visual orientation filter for image/video providers.

platforms.description: Comma-separated platforms. Defaults to providers relevant to kind. Supported: pexels, pixabay, unsplash, freesound.

projectId.description: Existing project ID from the editor URL or list_projects. Pass this when continuing work on an existing project and the external MCP session is not already targeted.

query.description: Search phrase, e.g. 'startup office', 'cash register beep', 'upbeat corporate'.
